refresh_log.summary: Competitor refresh for the window: 3 official-page price/plan changes (Stock Rover, Koyfin, Yahoo Finance) plus TradingView SG, Seeking Alpha, Wisesheets and ChatGPT updates, the AlphaSense USD 7.5B raise, and dated events on 24 incumbents (Yahoo AlphaSpace, Bloomberg ASKB, FactSet, S&P ChatIQ, Moomoo, Tiger, OCBC and others); 7 new entrants are listed separately and left unscored. No citable change found for Finbox, AInvest, SGX StockFacts, Trefis or DIY Excel; low-confidence third-party prices are flagged UNVERIFIED and did not overwrite recorded prices.

top_five.rationale: Closest like-for-like: AI-narrated equity analysis on retail-friendly chrome, freemium gateway, framework-driven (Snowflake = 5 axes). Owns the 'guided fundamental analysis' lane that Market Tracker is trying to enter from a Booth-academic angle.

The pro-grade free alternative that retail prosumers and boutique analysts actually use. Sets the bar for chart density, ratio coverage, and data freshness — the 'good enough vs Bloomberg' anchor in any sub-USD 50/mo segment.

Direct US-equity screening + ratio-driven analysis competitor; subscription-priced; targets self-directed value investors using academic frameworks. Closest to the Booth-EMBA buyer's existing toolset.

The free academic gold-standard. Aswath Damodaran's NYU Stern spreadsheets are what Booth EMBA candidates already download for DCF, WACC, cost-of-equity. Largest 'competitor' by mass: the user already has it.
The default reflex. Free, ubiquitous, 0-friction. If Market Tracker doesn't deliver something Yahoo Finance can't, the buyer churns immediately. Sets the floor on what 'free' must include.
